title: Vivaldi browser profiles
whyItMatters: Vivaldi profiles are separate browsing identities with their own history and sign-ins, which matter before a handover.
notes: Chromium-style profile folders (Default, Profile 1, ...), each identified by its Preferences file. No file content is read.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Vivaldi export bookmarks with the import and export tool, and save any passwords you keep in the browser.
cleanup.signOut: In Vivaldi open the sync settings and sign out, so the sync account no longer holds this profile's data.
steps: Close every Vivaldi window so the profile files are not in use.
Move Vivaldi to the Trash from Applications and empty the Trash.
Delete the Vivaldi folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Removes every Vivaldi profile on this Mac: history, cookies, saved logins and bookmarks.
